Crows remember faces. So will you. Biotechnica's first bird form is sold to investigators, gossip columnists and anyone who wants to repeat what they heard in someone else's voice.

Package: Minor
Humanity Loss: 16
Includes: Exotic Bodysculpting (feathers and beak), AudioVox, Cybereye ×2 w/ Image Enhance ×2 and Color Shift ×2, Memory Boost, Talon Foot ×2

Install the pieces it includes as cyberware; the package price covers them all.
